## Change / Mudança

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation / Validação

List the checks actually run and their results. For visual changes, include before/after evidence and viewport/theme details. State any remaining limitation.

## Review / Revisão

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and both READMEs are consistent where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or private project content were added.
- [ ] Any included third-party code or assets have their source and license recorded.
